description: This file defines structures, enums, and function declarations related to Type 1 and Type 2 font tables in the FreeType project, including font info, private data, and font-related functions.

methods.name: FT_Has_PS_Glyph_Names
methods.description: Returns true if a face provides reliable Postscript glyph names.

methods.name: FT_Get_PS_Font_Info
methods.description: Retrieves the PS_FontInfoRec structure for a given Postscript font.
